m.d: Any of three species of small grouse in the genus Lagopus found in subarctic tundra areas of North America and Eurasia.
A member of Pteranodon, a genus of large pterosaurs, the males of which had a bony crest on the back of the head.
A pterodactyl is a large flying reptile that lived in the time of the dinosaurs.
Any flying reptile, of the extinct order †Pterosauria, including the pterodactyls.
Of or pertaining to the astronomer Claudius Ptolemy.
Any of various amines formed by putrefactive bacteria.
